name: Othniel
summary: The son of Kenaz and younger brother of Caleb, who took a city to win Caleb's daughter Achsah. When Israel cried out after eight years under the king of Mesopotamia, the LORD raised him up as a deliverer, and the land had rest forty years.

key_moments.title: Takes Kirjath-sepher and Wins Achsah
key_moments.description: Caleb promised his daughter Achsah as wife to the man who took Kirjath-sepher. Othniel took it, and Caleb gave him Achsah.

key_moments.title: Raised Up to Deliver Israel
key_moments.description: Israel forgot the LORD and served Baalim, so the LORD sold them to Chushan-rishathaim, king of Mesopotamia, for eight years. When they cried to the LORD, He raised up Othniel to deliver them.

key_moments.title: Defeats the King of Mesopotamia
key_moments.description: The Spirit of the LORD came upon Othniel, and he judged Israel and went out to war. The LORD gave Chushan-rishathaim into his hand, and the land had rest forty years.
